label: sparse D1-only feature, weakly enriched for rewarded D1 with an undecided policy
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2), but on only about 5% of D1 steps, so phase alone has precision 0.05. Within D1 no predicate built from observed variables gets past F1 of about 0.21. The best one (recorded) is a rewarded D1 (in_rew == 1) where the model policy logit is near indifferent (|choice| < 2): dev P 0.15, R 0.34, mass recall 0.50. Weaker enrichments: the upcoming choice is a switch (stay == 0 at D1, rate 6.3% vs 1.5%, a future variable, F1 0.20), the previous transition was rare (2.8% vs 1.5%), late-episode trials (80-99), and low value (< 7.13). It almost never fires when the policy is confident (|choice| > ~4.5) or value is high (> 8.1). Model-based pattern predicates (rare-rewarded, common-unrewarded) score F1 < 0.14. Magnitude was not mapped to any variable. The feature is not explained by the task variables available.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over trial before (D1: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, ?) and last trial (D1: a1 S2 r, a1 S2 u, a2 S2 r); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=8, rel=-3, phase=D1 & ep_dec=9.
